title: Remove an antibonding electron
statement:
A molecular ion forms by removing one antibonding electron from the neutral. How does the model’s bond order change?

[_]{a}

explanations: Subtracting one fewer antibonding electron raises the difference.
That is the effect of adding an antibonding electron.
The formula divides the occupancy difference by two.

hints: Write half the difference between bonding and antibonding populations.
solution: Write half the difference between bonding and antibonding populations. Bonding population is unchanged. Antibonding population decreases by one. Subtracting one fewer antibonding electron raises the difference.
